parsed.rationale: Both participating records have `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Wallpaper/Tests/WallpaperTests/QualityMetricsAggregatorTests.swift`. Although the Jaccard similarity is high (0.8636), the two methods — `tracksInterpolationEnabledPercent` (line 266) and `countsInterpolationActivations` (line 374) — have distinct names that indicate they are testing different observable behaviours of `QualityMetricsAggregator` (a percentage-tracking path vs. an activation-counting path). Near-duplicate structure in test methods is common and intentional when exercising closely related but semantically distinct code paths; collapsing them would obscure test intent and make failure diagnosis harder.
